Lakmé Fashion Week Features Celebrity Showstoppers

The Lakmé Fashion Week 2026, held from October 13 to 18 in New Delhi, featured several celebrity showstoppers. Actor Ali Fazal closed the second day of the event, while Nitanshi Goel and Tejasswi Prakash also walked the runway. Goel showcased a wine-colored, embellished fishtail lehenga from Suneet Varma's 'Kashi' collection.
